svg.text: Six roles, two abstract actors and three external systems. A lane holds one actor's own use cases; the column on the left is what any signed-in account can do.
Dashed arrow: <<include>>, a step the use case always pulls in. Hollow triangle: an actor generalisation, read as "is a".
PAPEL: Research Repository and Archiving System
Sign in with ID and password
Set a new password at first sign-in
Save a paper to My Library
Receive a notice in-app and by email
Choose a view, a theme or Zen Mode
Enrol a list from a spreadsheet
Set the Google Drive storage folder
View analytics and export a report
Grant, deny or revoke manuscript access
Store the file on Google Drive
Read the PDF with the AI engine
